title: iOS Developer
description: Build native applications for Apple devices. Master Swift programming, SwiftUI layout components, data grids, and CoreData cache.

nodes.title: Swift Syntax & Classes
nodes.description: Understand variables types, Swift Optionals, structs vs classes, protocols, optionals chaining, and error catches.
projectIdeas: Build a localized terminal task utility in Swift demonstrating protocol inheritance classes.
interviewQuestions: Explain Swift optionals and the difference between if-let and guard-let bindings.
What is the difference between a Struct and a Class in Swift?

nodes.title: SwiftUI Declarative Layouts
nodes.description: Build user interfaces using VStack, HStack, List, state bindings (@State, @Binding), and layout updates.
projectIdeas: Build a custom weather view list demonstrating bindings transitions and dynamic layout grids.
interviewQuestions: What is the purpose of @StateObject vs @ObservedObject in SwiftUI?
Explain the layout layout flow of SwiftUI view trees.
